requests.name: Check josephithomas/ecc Fork
requests.testScript: pw.test("Status is 200", () => { pw.expect(pw.response.status).toBe(200); }); pw.test("Repo is a fork of affaan-m/ECC", () => { const body = pw.response.body; pw.expect(body.fork).toBe(true); pw.expect(body.parent.full_name).toBe("affaan-m/ECC"); });
